title: Does the sequence of clamp application during open abdominal aortic aneurysm surgery influence distal embolisation?
abstract: Embolisation of atherosclerotic debris during abdominal aortic aneurysm (AAA) repair is responsible for significant peri-operative morbidity. Reports have suggested that preferential clamping of the distal vessel(s) before the proximal aorta may decrease the number of emboli passing distally and hence reduce complications.
journal: European journal of vascular and endovascular surgery : the official journal of the European Society for Vascular Surgery
